mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have fair conditions and a comfortable temperature of 70 degrees near Verona City Hall. Clear skies tonight will allow for a 2-minute view of the International Space Station starting at 6:34 PM, traveling from Cross Plains in the northwest toward Madison in the northeast, low near the horizon.

In city news, Verona is advancing plans for the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to enhance year-round accessibility. Following recent bridge work, the city will host a public information meeting on Tuesday, December 8th, at the Verona Senior Center to present trail designs, detours, and construction timelines.
For local events, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, trivia nights will be hosted at Hop Haus Brewing, Lake Lou-ee Brewing, and Paddy Mac's.

In police updates, on Saturday, October twenty-fifth, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a driver passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for O W I first offence.
Finally, Culver's is open today until 10 PM, serving Chocolate Volcano as the daily flavor.
